python3 -B - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json, re, sys
import yaml
root=Path.cwd()
slugs={'vragen-en-hulp','architectuur-en-ontwerp','product-en-gebruikservaring','testresultaten-en-demos'}
forms=list(Path('.github/DISCUSSION_TEMPLATE').glob('*.yml'))+[p for p in Path('.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE').glob('*.yml') if p.name!='config.yml']
assert {p.stem for p in Path('.github/DISCUSSION_TEMPLATE').glob('*.yml')}==slugs
for p in forms:
 d=yaml.safe_load(p.read_text()); assert isinstance(d,dict) and isinstance(d['body'],list)
 assert not d.get('labels') and not d.get('assignees')
 if 'ISSUE_TEMPLATE' in p.parts: assert len(d['name'])>3 and d['description']
 else: assert set(d)<={'title','labels','body'}
 ids=set(); labels=set(); count=0
 for f in d['body']:
  assert f['type'] in {'markdown','input','textarea','dropdown','checkboxes'}
  a=f['attributes']
  if f['type']=='markdown': assert isinstance(a['value'],str); continue
  count+=1; fid=f['id']; assert re.fullmatch('[A-Za-z0-9_-]+',fid) and fid not in ids; ids.add(fid)
  assert a['label'] not in labels; labels.add(a['label'])
  if 'validations' in f: assert type(f['validations']['required']) is bool
  if f['type']=='dropdown':
   opts=a['options']; assert opts and all(isinstance(x,str) for x in opts) and len(set(opts))==len(opts)
 assert count
config=yaml.safe_load(Path('.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml').read_text())
assert config['blank_issues_enabled'] is False and len(config['contact_links'])==4
md=Path('.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/implementation_task.md').read_text()
fm=yaml.safe_load(md.split('---',2)[1]); assert fm['name'] and fm['about']
assert not fm.get('labels') and not fm.get('assignees')
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'tools'))
from agent_pipeline import parse_issue,open_criteria
progress=json.loads(Path('docs/progress.json').read_text())
body=md.replace('VUL_OPEN_ID_IN','K06').replace('VUL_WORKFLOW.yml#VUL_JOB_IN','ci.yml#host-quality')
issue={'number':999999,'title':'in-memory template validation','body':body,'labels':[{'name':'pipeline:serial'}]}
task=parse_issue(issue,open_criteria(progress))
assert task.criterion=='K06' and task.gates==['ci.yml#host-quality'] and task.deps==[]
assert 'host-quality' in yaml.safe_load(Path('.github/workflows/ci.yml').read_text())['jobs']
issue['body']=body+'\nAfhankelijk van: #39\n'
assert parse_issue(issue,open_criteria(progress)).deps==[39]
issue['labels']=[]
try: parse_issue(issue,open_criteria(progress))
except ValueError: pass
else: raise AssertionError('task accepted without pipeline label')
files=forms+[Path('.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml'),Path('.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/implementation_task.md'),Path('.github/pull_request_template.md'),Path('docs/COMMUNITY.md')]
checked=0
for p in files:
 for target in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)',p.read_text()):
  if target.startswith('https://github.com/simonvanieperen/nieuw-os/blob/main/'):
   dest=root/target.split('/blob/main/',1)[1].split('#')[0]
  elif '://' not in target and not target.startswith('#'):
   dest=p.parent/target.split('#')[0]
  else: continue
  assert dest.is_file(),(p,str(dest)); checked+=1
assert 'docs/COMMUNITY.md' in Path('README.md').read_text()
assert 'docs/COMMUNITY.md' in Path('CONTRIBUTING.md').read_text()
baseline=json.loads(__import__('subprocess').check_output(['git','show','363b486b06023d3d578f8eca2b23ff49045a1757:docs/progress.json']))
assert progress['tracks']==baseline['tracks'] and progress['rubric_version']==baseline['rubric_version']
print(json.dumps({'forms':len(forms),'task_parser':'passed; no hidden dependency; rejects missing label','repository_file_links':checked,'score_criteria':'unchanged','category_slugs':sorted(slugs)},ensure_ascii=False))
